name: Maki Fes!
source: You are [insert your name here], an ordinary high school student, except you've got Love Live's Maki herself wrapped around your big dick in all her tsundere glory. One day she calls you to the music room, asking you for inspiration for a new tune. Unfortunately, you're not very good at music. Fortunately, you are very inspiring in bed.
translation: 你是【填写名字】，普通高中生，但Love Live的傲娇偶像真姫正缠在你巨大的肉棒上。某天，她把你叫到音乐教室，请你为新曲寻找灵感。遗憾的是，你不擅长音乐。幸运的是，你在床上非常有灵感。
